sample_unit: ambulatory providers (three surgeons in the surgical subgroup)

links.outcome: Billing metrics, pajama time, mental demand, and burnout after ambient AI scribe pilot
links.effect: Billing showed no significant changes, so no upcoding signal. Pajama time did not change (p=0.55). NASA-TLX mental demand fell 14 to 5 (p=0.08), and burnout fell from 67% to 33%.
links.quote: The billing metric showed no significant changes.

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world deployment of an ambient AI scribe in surgical outpatient clinics measuring physician workload, burnout, and patient experience, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice variation.
